gaps.lead: 'I'll call you as soon as I land,' she said.
gaps.sentence: She promised ___ as soon as she landed.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call (me); pronouns shift.

gaps.lead: The lecture was cancelled because nobody came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.

gaps.lead: People think she was the best singer of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the best singer of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event uses is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: was unable to = couldn't (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: Only after reading the letter twice did it make sense.
gaps.sentence: The letter ___ sense until it had been read twice.
gaps.explanation: It made sense only after two readings = it didn't make sense until it had been read twice.

gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: the school in which my mother teaches = where my mother teaches.
